QuestInfo.name: Papulatus's counterattack
QuestInfo.0: I thought there would be no problem in the clock tower since I stopped the crack of dimension and got rid of #o8500002#, but I still have things to do. Let's go to #b#p2041021##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2041021# said that once the crack occurs on the wall of dimension, it becomes weak so that can easily have holes. He was worried that #o8500002# will attack again. #p2041021# asked me to check out on #b#p2041023##k monitoring around the operation room if  #o8500002# comes in.
QuestInfo.2: #p2041023# said #o8500002# invaded again showing me the evidence of a piece of dimension crack. He asked me to get rid of #o8500002# as I once killed #o8500002# that I can do it again...

0.0: 안녕하세요, 강하고 현명하고 용감한 모험가님~! 당신 덕분에 새로운 시간의 구를 만들어 시계탑의 힘을 유지시킬 수 있었습니다! 정말 감사했어요! 그런데... 당신께서 도와주신게 다 소용없게 되어 버리는 것 같아 걱정이네요. 무슨 일이냐고요?
0.1: 한 번 구멍이 뚫렸던 차원의 벽은 예전 같은 힘을 잃어버렸답니다. 차원의 균열을 막아 틈을 없앴지만 이젠 약간의 충격에도 금방 구멍이 생기게 되고 말았어요. 그 틈을 타서 다시 한 번 파풀라투스가 공격해 들어오는 것은 아닐지 걱정이네요.
0.2: 그래서 말인데... 모험가님께서 플로에게 가보시지 않겠어요? 차원의 벽에 무슨 일이 생길 때를 대비해서, 플로가 동력실을 감시중이거든요. 모험가님께서 플로에게 가서, 혹시라도 무슨 일이 생기지는 않았는지 확인해 주세요!

yes.0: 역시! 정의로운 모험가님이라면 그렇게 대답하실 줄 알았죠! 훗훗! 그렇다면 어서 플로에게 가주세요!

no.0: 흐음~ 곤란하신 건가요? 슬프네요. 모험가님이라면 틀림없이 도와주실 거라고 생각했는데...

0.0: Hello, wise and brave adventurer! Thanks to you, the power of Clocktower wa maintained! Thank you so much. But now I'm worried that all of your hard work was for nothing. What happened, you ask?
0.1: Since being broken through once, the wall of dimension has lost its power. The Dimensional Schism has been blocked now, but even a slight shock can create a crack again. I'm worried that #o8500002# will take advantage of the current situation and start attacking any minute.
0.2: So I was hoping that you can head over to see #p2041023#. #p2041023# is monitoring the Power Room to make sure nothing happens. Please talk to #b#p2041023##k and make sure nothing has happened!

yes.0: I knew you'd say that! I wouldn't expect anything less from such an honorable adventurer! Hehe. Please go see #p2041023# now!

no.0: Hm... Is it an inconvenience? I was almost certain you'd agree to help. Well, that makes me sad...

1.0: Wait a minute! Who is that? You are the adventurer who defeated #o8500002#! You certain arrived at the perfect time because we really need your help! Here, take a look! \n\n #i4031179# #t4031179#
1.1: I found a #t4031179# while patrolling the Power Room. Seeing how this was just laying around in the Power Room, it leads me to believe that #o8500002# has penetrated the wall of dimension and invaded the Clocktower already!
1.2: If you've defeated #o8500002# once, doing so again won't be too difficult, right? Here, I'll give you this. Please go back to the Power Room one more time and eliminate #o8500002#. I'm counting on you!

yes.0: Based on the records I have here from patrolling, #t4031179# has been found once a day. Sigh... The wall of dimension must have weakened significantly. I can't believe this is happening. This time, we're okay because you're here to help... But what will we do when #o8500002# appears again? Oh, I wish someone would continue to help us defeat #o8500002#...

npc.0: Oh, it seems like you haven't gone over to see #b#p2041023##k yet. #p2041023# is in charge of guarding the Power Room, so if anything happened to the wall of dimension, he'll know all about it.
